default.title: Need help planning your trip?
default.body: Talk to our team on WhatsApp or start a booking — we reply quickly.

hajj.title: Planning Hajj?
hajj.body: Get package details, seats and payment guidance from our Hajj desk.

umrah.title: Ready for Umrah?
umrah.body: Ask about dates, hotels near Haram, and current Umrah offers.

visa.title: Need a visa?
visa.body: Share your destination — we will guide documents and processing time.

air.title: Looking for tickets?
air.body: Send your route and dates for a quick fare quote.

packages.title: Found a package you like?
packages.body: We can confirm availability and customize for your group.

manpower.title: Overseas job guidance
manpower.body: Ask about legal recruitment, BMET steps and destination options.

hotel.title: Need a hotel?
hotel.body: Tell us city, dates and budget — we will shortlist options.

transport.title: Need a transfer?
transport.body: Airport pickup, Ziyarah and group transport available.

book.title: Stuck on the booking form?
book.body: Message us on WhatsApp — we will complete it with you.

contact.title: Prefer a quick chat?
contact.body: WhatsApp is fastest — or call our 24/7 support line.

pwa.title: Install SM Travels
pwa.body: Add to your home screen for faster booking and offline access.
